notes: Final Mars DTB enables TRNG via jh7110-milkv-mars.dtsi override; production VibeOS firmware has no TRNG mapping or registration
Reset belongs to SEC_TOP and is also used by crypto/security DMA; no driver-owned reset is allowed
Polling transport requires firmware to mask PLIC IRQ and exclusively own ISTAT
Requires preconfigured mission/non-nonce mode with readback; no undocumented SMODE programming
Reads conditioned 256-bit blocks; zero/all-one/consecutive-duplicate rejection is not an entropy estimate
Every block explicitly reseeds; faults disable interrupts and require owner recovery without automatic commands
Neither Linux driver presence nor model success qualifies this source for production SSH
